html:
The British Crown colony of the Gold Coast, proclaimed on 24 July 1874 over the coastal states after the war against Asante, with its capital moved to Accra in 1877.

Asante was added in 1901 and the Northern Territories as a protectorate; after the First World War part of German Togoland joined it too. Under British rule, gold mining and above all cocoa, grown by African farmers, made it the richest colony in West Africa, with more schools than most. Its educated elite led early nationalism, and in 1957 it became independent as Ghana under Kwame Nkrumah. See also the Anglo-Ashanti wars.
sum: The British Crown colony of the Gold Coast, proclaimed on 24 July 1874 over the coastal states after the war against Asante, with its capital moved to Accra in 1877.
